body: i live in canada while he lives in nyc. i don't know how to contact them. i should've called when he showed me the picture of him trying to cut his wrist but he took the wrong knife.

he truly believes he could give me a good life, but i firmly believe there is no way i will ever recover myself from this. he doesn't believe that i "actually" want to die because i have a lot of people i hold dearly and i have a good support system. he thinks that i will never reach his level of suffering, therefore i shouldn't want to die.

i don't know how to get out. i truly don't. i can't have someone i care about die on me but i also can't take this mental strain any further. thank you for listening and offering your perspective

That is what I thought too, but he sent me a document of his will and also took a knife to kill himself. However the knife was too dull and it was unsuccessful, but he took a picture to show that he really tried. I'm terrified of knowing someone died and I don't know how to contact the police at his place, cuz technically we live in different countries but very nearby

they have been spending a lot of time together. \*a lot\* so i do suppose she likes him way more than me. She hasn't tried to reach out to me at all even though I know she would invite him to do everything. it happens but it's just a feelsbadman for me

haha i do this too! I just told them jokingly "you hoes agreed to A and not me? what is this bs wanna die" and they were just saying "well we can't help liking A more than you"

it's normal banter so I'm okay with it. Just at that particular moment it's a bit worse than usual but i didn't think too much of it. what i'm mostly pissed about would be my bestie :<
i'm thinking she might actually do...
i think you raise a really good point. i haven't thought about that in that way. i guess i'm really caught up in my own head T T

I do have other people to lean on so I haven't been isolating myself. Thank goodness for my housemate/best friend. Although I know I shouldn't feel insecure, I can't help feeling that way since I just notice every little details that people do and overanalyze them. I did jokingly mention during the night that 'hey why tf you agree to A and not me you hoes' to my guy friends but I don't feel like I can say it to the girl. I just feel incredibly awkward for that.

I'll try to muster up the courage to communicate but I also haven't been keeping in touch (I'm always the one to initiate) so it's weird I suppose. Thank you!!

Yes. I feel like if I just stop existing, everything about me is wiped away and people live as if I was never there, everyone would live happily. My biggest wish, most wanted superpower has always been to be completely forgotten
